SourceProxy.label: SHYX Skeleton End Clipper
SourceProxy.name: SHYXSkeletonEndClipper

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Skeleton End Clipper: Extract skeleton then clip vessel ends (two outputs).

SourceProxy.Documentation:
One-node combination of SHYX Skeleton Extraction and SHYX Vessel End Clipper. The two standalone filters are unchanged. Input is a watertight vessel surface.
Outputs: - Port 0 (Clipped Mesh): vessel mesh with tips clipped (and optionally capped) - Port 1 (Skeleton + Clip Planes): skeleton polylines plus clip-plane labels (vertex cells) and short direction lines. First display uses Point Label (VertexOnly labels only clip origins, not skeleton vertices).

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Closed (watertight) vessel surface mesh. Skeleton extraction requires a closed triangle mesh; clipping uses that surface plus the internally extracted centerline.

IntVectorProperty.name: MaxIterations
IntVectorProperty.label: Max Iterations
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Maximum number of skeleton contraction iterations.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MaxTriangleAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Max Triangle Angle (deg)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Local remeshing parameter for skeleton extraction (CGAL max_triangle_angle). Unit is degrees.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MinEdgeLength
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Min Edge Length
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Local remeshing parameter for skeleton extraction (CGAL min_edge_length). Values <= 0 use 0.002 times the longest AABB side.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: AreaThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Area Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Area variation factor controlling skeleton contraction convergence.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: QualitySpeedTradeoff
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Quality / Speed Tradeoff (w_H)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Skeleton contraction speed vs quality (CGAL quality_speed_tradeoff, w_H).

IntVectorProperty.name: MediallyCentered
IntVectorProperty.label: Medially Centered
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, medial centering is applied during skeleton extraction.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MediallyCenteredSpeedTradeoff
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Medial Centering Tradeoff (w_M)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Smoothness of medial approximation (CGAL medially_centered_speed_tradeoff, w_M). Only used if Medially Centered is ON.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ClipOffset
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Clip Offset
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Offset distance to shift each cutting plane along the centerline tangent. Positive values move the plane outward, negative values move it inward.

IntVectorProperty.name: TangentDepth
IntVectorProperty.label: Tangent Depth
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Number of skeleton edges to walk inward from each leaf when estimating the local tangent for the cutting plane.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MinBranchLength
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Min Branch Length
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Minimum centerline branch length for an endpoint to be checked by default. Set to 0 to check all endpoints.

IntVectorProperty.name: CapEndpoints
IntVectorProperty.label: Cap Endpoints
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, holes created by clipping are filled with CGAL hole fairing.

IntVectorProperty.name: FairingContinuity
IntVectorProperty.label: Capping Fairing Continuity
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When Cap Endpoints is ON: 0 = C0, 1 = C1, 2 = C2 (CGAL fairing_continuity).

StringVectorProperty.name: EndpointStatus
StringVectorProperty.label: Endpoints to Clip
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Select which skeleton leaf endpoints to clip. Apply once first to discover endpoints from the extracted centerline.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseUpdateAttributes
IntVectorProperty.label: Interpolate attributes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, attributes will be interpolated unto the clipped mesh (port 0).

IntVectorProperty.name: UseInteractiveCutPlanes
IntVectorProperty.label: Show Interactive Cut Planes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON, yellow per-endpoint plane widgets are shown. Turning it OFF only hides the widgets; clipping still uses InteractiveCutPacked when present.

StringVectorProperty.name: InteractiveCutPacked
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Internal: packed interactive state (6 doubles per endpoint). Managed by the custom panel widget.

StringVectorProperty.name: OutputMessage
StringVectorProperty.label: Last update reason
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Read-only text from the last pipeline update (skeleton size and clipper message).
